description: This file contains unit tests for the CatalogItemsSpecification class in the ApplicationCore.Specifications namespace. It tests the behavior of the specification in matching specific catalog items, using the NSubstitute mocking framework and xUnit testing framework.

classes.name: CatalogItemsSpecification
classes.description: Unit test class for CatalogItemsSpecification, testing its matching logic with various catalog item IDs.

methods.name: MatchesSpecificCatalogItem
methods.description: Tests that the specification matches a specific catalog item based on its ID.

methods.name: MatchesAllCatalogItems
methods.description: Tests that the specification correctly matches multiple catalog items.

methods.description: Creates a test collection of CatalogItem substitutes for testing purposes.
